rules.message: IAS UVP URLs in the declared ad session contain different external session IDs.
rules.fix_hint: Populate every UVP URL in this ad session with the same stable ad-server session ID.

rules.message: The same IAS external session ID appears in multiple declared ad sessions.
rules.fix_hint: Generate a distinct stable external session ID for each ad session. IAS recommends UUIDv4.
